articles.summary: Experts encourage beneficiaries to review coverage carefully and remain alert to potential Medicare fraud Mattoon, IL (October 6, 2026) As millions of Medicare beneficiaries prepare to review their coverage during the upcoming Open Enrollment period, First Mid Insurance Groups (FMIG) Senior Solutions division is entering the season with national recognition for its performance and expertise in serving Medicare clients. In Senior Marketing Specialists (SMS) latest Key Accounts Leaderboard, FMIG earned four top 10 rankings among 67 key accounts, including third place in ancillary product sales and attachment rate, fifth in Medicare Advantage and prescription drug plan applications, and sixth in year-over-year growth. The Senior Solutions team also submitted 73 more applications in 2026 than at the same point last year. articles.summary: Putnam, IL (October 28, 2026) First Mid Ag Services, a division of First Mid Wealth Management, has entered into an agreement to acquire Winship Farm Management, based in Putnam, Illinois. The transition of farm management responsibilities will begin January 1, 2027, and continue through 2029. Founded by Harold and Judy Winship in 2004, Winship Farm Management provides comprehensive farm management services to landowners across west central Illinois, primarily in Knox, Warren, Henderson, Henry, and Mercer counties. During the transition, Harold and Judy will remain actively involved to provide continuity for clients as they work toward retirement. It has been our privilege to serve our clients for more than 20 years, said Harold Winship. We are grateful for the trust they have placed in us and are confident that First Mid Ag Services has the team, expertise, and processes needed to serve them well into the future. articles.title: First Mid Ag Services to Acquire Winship Farm Management

articles.summary: Simple steps can help protect online accounts digital wallets plus personal financial information St. Louis, MO (October 21, 2026) From online banking and shopping to email and payment apps, personal and financial information is more accessible than ever before. During Cybersecurity Awareness Month, First Mid Bank Trust (First Mid) is encouraging consumers to take a closer look at how they protect themselves online. Even some of the strongest security settings can be undermined when consumers are tricked into providing information to bypass their own defenses. For example, a scammer may use information from a data breach or social media to impersonate a bank in a text message, creating a convincing alert that urges someone to click a link and share their login credentials. articles.title: First Mid Bank & Trust Encourages Consumers to Step Up Their Digital Security During Cybersecurity Awareness Month

articles.summary: MATTOON, Ill. and WELLSVILLE, Mo., Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First Mid Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: FMBH) (“First Mid”) and Evergreen Bancshares, Inc. (“Evergreen”), the parent company of American Bank of Freedom, announced the execution of a definitive agreement dated October 28, 2026 under which Evergreen will merge with First Mid in a stock and cash transaction, strengthening First Mid’s presence in St. Louis and along the I-70 corridor, expanding its Illinois franchise through Rochester, and establishing a full-service banking presence in the greater Indianapolis market. American Bank of Freedom is headquartered in Wellsville, Missouri and operates 10 banking centers, including locations throughout the St. Louis metropolitan area and I-70 corridor, as well as banking centers in Rochester, Illinois and Westfield, Indiana.
